explanation: The narrowest crossing, from near Dover to Cap Gris-Nez, is about 33 km (about 21 miles). Channel swimmers often swim much further, as the tides sweep them along an S-shaped route.

claims.text: The Strait of Dover is about 33 km wide at its narrowest point, between near Dover in England and Cap Gris-Nez in France.
Tides push Channel swimmers along an S-shaped course, so they swim further than the straight-line distance.
